origin: Devised in 2005 by the data visualization expert Stephen Few to replace gauges on dashboards. Its thin, long bar is shaped like a bullet.
whenToUse: A dashboard holds several metrics with targets.
You show which rating band a value falls in.
whenNotToUse: There's no target or standard (use a bar chart).
There's only one metric to show large (use a gauge).
Change over time (use a line chart).

alternatives.name: KPI Card
alternatives.reason: Showing only the number and its change.

accessibility: Announce the value and target together with role="meter" and aria-valuetext.
Rating bands are split only by shades of gray, so color doesn't carry a second meaning.
The band thresholds are written out separately.
